Frequently Asked Questions

How much does it cost to hire a 1T mini excavator in Sydney?+

BuildHire's 1T Kubota U10-5 starts from $200/day incl GST. Delivery and collection is $110. Call 1300 157 882 for weekly rates.

Do I need a licence to operate a 1T mini excavator in NSW?+

No licence is required on private property in NSW. On a registered worksite a High Risk Work Licence may be required.

Can the Kubota U10-5 work indoors?+

Yes. The foldable ROPS allows the machine to pass through standard doorways and work inside warehouses, garages, and basements.

What is the difference between the 0.8T and 1T mini excavator?+

The 1T Kubota U10-5 offers greater dig depth (1,800mm vs 1,510mm), more breakout force (1,060kgf), and a foldable ROPS for indoor work.

How quickly can BuildHire deliver in Sydney?+

Next-day delivery for bookings before 12pm. Same-day may be available — call 1300 157 882.
